entries.6b12ce70cd19a0ca: As its raison d'être (purpose), based on its management philosophy, the company aims to realize 'Sustainable Supply': turning off-grade eggs that do not reach the market into liquid and frozen egg, providing a stable volume at stable quality and fair prices, and building continuing relationships with customers.
